verdict.rationale: The public guidance surface on dor.wa.gov was retrieved as readable text: substantive passages were extracted from the business-license, B&O tax, MyDOR-help and home pages. The probe record calls these "open dor.wa.gov guidance pages", and the pipeline UA received ordinary HTTP 404s there rather than a challenge page. The login wall on secure.dor.wa.gov covers only the transactional portal (license applications, tax returns), not the published reading surface. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 server-rendered HTML on a guidance page under an identified UA, and independent confirmation that no CAPTCHA or bot challenge appears across the guidance site.
